Electromagnetic radiation travels through materials or space as transverse waves
Electromagnetic waves consist of perpendicular electric and magnetic fields
Wavelength is the distance between wave crests
Amplitude is the height of a wave
Frequency is the number of waves that pass in a given time
Period is the time it takes for one wave to occur
The electromagnetic spectrum is the range of frequencies of electromagnetic radiation

Wavelength and frequency are inversely related
Energy of electromagnetic waves increases with frequency
